name: otus-app
description: Otus Wallet: a self-custodial Solana wallet that reviews every transaction before it is signed

scripts.sdk:local: d=$(mktemp -d) && npm pack ../otus-sdk --pack-destination $d --loglevel=error >/dev/null && rm -rf node_modules/@otus-wallet/sdk && mkdir -p node_modules/@otus-wallet/sdk && tar -xzf $d/*.tgz -C node_modules/@otus-wallet/sdk --strip-components=1 && rm -rf $d
